pr_title: dxf: fix the task num count incorrectly
pr_body: ### What problem does this PR solve? Issue Number: close #57172 Problem Summary: ### What changed and how does it work? The task count metric is updating in scheduler loop, but the task maybe cleaned up in `doCleanupTask()`, the scheduler will not handle the finished/failed... state, so the task count metric will not be reduced. ### Check List Tests - [ ] Unit test - [ ] Integration test - [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below) Use sysbench prepare 100 tables with 10000 rows. Watch the pannel: - [ ] No need to test > - [ ] I checked and no code files have been changed. > Side effects - [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more CPU - [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more Memory - [ ] Breaking backward compatibility Documentation - [ ] Affects user behaviors - [ ] Contains syntax changes - [ ] Contains variable changes - [ ] Contains experimental features - [ ] Changes MySQL compatibility ### Release note Please refer to [Release Notes Language Style Guide](https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/release-notes-style-guide.html) to write a quality release note. ```release-note None ```
